title: Oats with banana and peanut butter
steps: Put the oats and milk in a small pot over medium heat.

Bring to a gentle simmer and cook for 3 to 4 minutes, stirring often, until thick and creamy. Add a splash of water if it gets too thick. In the microwave: 2 to 3 minutes in a big bowl, stirring halfway.
Pour into a bowl and top with the sliced banana and the peanut butter, and a pinch of cinnamon if you like.
